project_goal: Source-grounded rules to support law finding and legal analysis; A/G/L is an information supply sub-study, not rule induction.
primary_scope: Delhi Rent Control Act s14(1)(b): subletting, assignment, parting with possession or consent; other rent laws and ordinary leases separate.
candidate_order_rule: Tier1 saved qualification-only candidates possibly within current14b scope; tier2 single local statute+issue scan. Within tier saved rank/locator order, otherwise numeric document ID. No outcome or method-benefit selection.
exposure_rule: Exclude prior tested answers/method-adjustment disputes; qualification-only screening is recorded and not automatic exclusion. Known related documents grouped; unknown relation marked.
corpus_rule: Existing development law sources plus explicit basic statutory law and adjacent sources; no target final reasons, same-dispute conclusions or target-answer-derived material. No mandatory library size.
slicing_rule: One source-boundary pass at complete statutory subsections/judicial paragraphs; exact offsets/maps retained. One minimal dependency determination and reachability check; no iterative budget-driven splitting.
query_rule: Issue, explicit allowed-record Act names and neutral facts only; freeze before reference.

representation_rule.G: Faithful general summary, including important legal conditions naturally
representation_rule.L: Legal conditions, effects, scope, authority status and exceptions

retries: Only identifiable transport/upload failure, same content once, main total <=2; JSON/semantic failures no retry; V23 no retries.
preselect_repeats: seed 20261003, min(2,n), before ranking and answers; new calls within each repeat.
evaluation: Finite source-anchored reference delivery rate, shared mandatory statute excluded from incremental denominator; macro defined cases; inaccessible items stay denominator; disputed sensitivity symmetric. Four paired net-effect classes plus SAME_TREATMENT; no accuracy/rule-learning claim.
failure_rule: Technical failure null; UNKNOWN substantive only. Failure retains case, does not trigger replacement or invented reference. Dependency stages blocked only; source/assembly error stops affected batch.
completion_rule: Finish predetermined batch or concrete stop; concentrated Chinese report, traces, ledger, freezes, history byte check, local bridge prepare/manifest/verify. No automatic commit/push/next research round.
legacy_costs: Old S01, historic experiments and two Pro reviews separately recorded; not included in 64 new call allowance.
source_identity_gate: Each response block has verified document URL/ID; byte positions and line anchors; reject identity conflicts, retain incompleteness and overlapping conflicts at freeze and task assembly.
scope_changes_from_previous: Relevant statute/issue candidate locator replaces broad queue
20 detailed/2 active hours/8 newly obtained target docs/3 optional queries
human_authorization: Current direct user explicitly authorizes next round and lifts previous after-delivery stop; follow current user requirements over archived earlier protocol.
